name: arch-map
title: 아키텍처 구조도 — 모듈 + 근거 검증
use: Draw a module map of one repo where every edge cites file/line/symbol, verify it, then its overview.
rules:
Target repo: in the request; read-only (no write, commit, checkout, build).
Write only under S = ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/<key>/<commit>/, key = `/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib,os,sys;print(hashlib.sha1(os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1]).encode()).hexdigest()[:16])" <repo>`.
Metadata only (names, paths, lines, symbols); no source text.
Edge kind: call = `from` calls at run time a function/method/constructor defined in `to` (evidence = that call site in `from`, symbol = called name); di = `from` gets a `to` instance by constructor/field/framework injection (Spring/Nest/Angular inject, FastAPI Depends, Go fields), evidence = the injection point in `from`; import = `from` only names a `to` type/constant (import/use, annotation, extends), no run-time call; config = wiring outside code (routes, compose, proxy, XML/YAML beans). Strongest proof wins: call > di > import. Injected or imported, calling a `to` symbol is call (that call site; a method only in an interface elsewhere stays di). read/write/serve/event: stage task.
Flow coverage: a flow covers only its entry's handler call chain, not the owning module's (serve edge `to`) other handlers; each from/to pair once (first proven call), by depth; over 40, keep the shallowest. FE screen entry: page -> FE api client (call) -> BE controller hop per static URL the page calls, then only those handlers' BE chain; the SPA-shell flow stops at the shell. FE->BE hop: evidence symbol = the static `/...` URL literal exactly as on the FE call line; to_evidence = the BE mapping line (symbol: path literal or annotation), always, even est=1. Over 40: drop deepest BE steps, upstream hops stay. FE->BE config edge with no BE flow: own flow if <=40 flows.
Quality checks (gate FAIL): labels only repeating the `to` module's id/name words on >=3 edges and >=25% of them (say what crosses); two flows with the same entry kind+label.
Overview (last 2 stages): writes only S/brief.json; its failed gate never invalidates the verified map.

stages.title: 읽기 계획
stages.task: commit = HEAD sha. Write S/plan.json: {v:2, repo:<realpath>, commit, base, arch:{style:layered|modular|apps|routes|feature-pkgs|feature-folders|crates|mvvm|hexagonal|library|other, framework:str<=80, units:str<=120, evidence:[1..5 files]}, groups:[{id, name<=60, file}], modules:[{id, path, globs}], entries:[{id, ext:http|hook|mcp|cli|file|job, file}], stores:[{id, ext:store|file|queue|db, file}], changed:[ids]}. groups = boundary cuts; file = proof. With an FE, http entries = FE screens (one per screen/feature: router path -> page module, file = router line); BE controllers = api modules, not entries; BE http entries only for external callers (server-key API, SPA shell, /_meta), named by route/prefix, never «X controllers (n)». modules = arch units, globs disjoint, no `**`, repo-relative. base = newest older commit dir in S/.. or null; changed = all module ids if no base map v 2, else modules in `git -C <repo> diff --name-only <base>..HEAD`. Write S/../../_last.json = {repo, commit}.

stages.title: 모듈 그리기
stages.task: Read plan.json + changed modules. Write S/map.json: {v:2, repo, commit, groups:[{id,name}], modules:[{id, name<=60, path, kind:module|external|entry|store, ext?, role?, layer, group, summary<=120, owns?:[ids]}], edges:[{from, to, kind:import|call|config|di|read|write|serve|event, label<=60, evidence:[{file, line, symbol}] 1..5, est?:0|1}]}; `v: 2`, no other keys. layer entry|ui|api|service|domain|data|infra|shared; by role: web->api, view,viewmodel->ui, service,app->service, domain,model,port->domain, adapter->infra, data/shared same. role (table keys): only layered/hexagonal/mvvm. group: plan.groups id. plan.entries/stores -> kind entry/store modules (same ext, layer entry/data), owns on owner. read|write module->store (evidence in from), serve entry->module (evidence in to; FE screen: component definition line, symbol = component name, not router), event module->module. Evidence line has the exact symbol (rules). Reuse base map modules/edges. Redo naming flows: redo flows.json.

stages.title: 흐름 그리기
stages.task: Read plan.json and map.json. Draw one flow per entry point (each serve edge's entry: HTTP route, CLI command, job, event/hook/MCP handler), at most 40, traced at the plan commit. Write S/flows.json only: {v:1, repo, commit, flows:[{id, name<=60, entry:{kind:http|cli|job|event|hook|mcp, label<=80}, steps:[{from, to, label<=60, evidence:{file, line, symbol}, to_evidence?:{file, line, symbol}, est?:0|1}] 1..40}]}. No other keys. from/to are map.json module ids; evidence is the call site in `from`: repo-relative file, line, and the exact case-sensitive symbol called there (defined in `to` unless to == from). An entry steps only to the module that owns its handler file (its serve edge's `to`; the page module for a FE screen entry); calls made inside that module's handlers start from it, never from the entry. Which handlers a flow covers: rules «Flow coverage». Fewer proven steps beat guesses; est=1 only for config/DI wiring.

stages.title: 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report its printed rate, flow line and quality line verbatim; when it fails, also report the schema error line(s) it printed (map.json v 2 keys) verbatim so Draw modules can fix them. It re-reads every cited file at the commit, drops unproven edges, marks unproven flow steps (advisory, never a failure), fails on rules «Quality checks» FAIL items too (report each named flow/edge so Draw modules can fix them), warns (never fails) on (avoid: two flows sharing >=80% of from/to pairs), call edges whose only symbols are accessors (getX/setX/isX/put/get/...: prefer import or cite the real call), modules with no edge and stores with no read/write edge, and writes verify.json + flows.verify.json + map.md. Do not edit map.json or flows.json. Read-only on the target repo; write only under the store dir.

stages.title: 개요 그리기
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_brief.py --pre --repo <repo>` once from the Sidereus folder (prints S); on a miss stop, edit nothing. Read S/map.json, S/verify.json. Write S/brief.json only: {v:1, repo:<realpath>, commit, title<=80, heads?:{arch<=40, route<=40}, bands:[{id, name<=40}] 1..4 top to bottom, boxes:[{id, name<=40, band, note?<=80, modules:[map module ids] 1..}] 1..12, arrows:[{from, to, label?<=40, edges:[map.json edges index] 1..5}] <=24, route:{na<=120} | {by<=80, rows:[{when<=80, goes<=120, box?, evidence:{file, line}}] 1..16}}. No other keys. Boxes group modules by domain/feature for a non-developer (what it does, not code layers); a module in <=1 box. Arrows cite verify-ok map edges joining their from/to boxes. route = how a request reaches a domain, in code decision order, each row citing the deciding line (repo-relative file, line at the commit); no router: {na: one line why}. Text in map.json's label language. brief.html/brief.ok.json: gate only.

stages.title: 개요 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report its printed line verbatim. It fails on unknown module/box/band ids, a module in two boxes, more than 12 boxes, an arrow edge that is not verified or does not join its boxes, and route evidence whose file:line does not exist at the commit; on pass it writes S/brief.html and S/brief.ok.json (sha256 of that html). Do not edit brief.json.
